verdict.rationale: Khoj's docs describe a full pipeline for attaching personal documents/notes (PDF, markdown, org-mode, Notion, GitHub) as a knowledge base that is indexed and used to ground chat/search responses, with desktop/Emacs/Obsidian clients syncing files for contextual answers. Community reports confirm the underlying search/index feature works offline and is functional, though one report notes degraded search quality for non-English (Slovenian) notes, which is a real caveat. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of end-to-end grounded-answer quality across all supported file types, and no benchmark/quality data beyond docs and mixed community anecdotes.
